Plat & Condo Maps
Home Government Register of Deeds Plat & Condo Maps
The Plat and Condo Maps are in Portable Document Format (PDF) and require a PDF viewing program. Adobe Reader 9 or newer (Adobe Website) is recommended. The file size of the Plat & Condo maps typically range between 200 KB to 400 KB depending on the features of each individual map. The file size of a limited number of maps is significantly larger.
For the online Plat and Condo Maps to function properly, it is recommended that you enable PDF viewing within your web browser.
For more information about Plat and Condo Maps, contact the Register of Deeds office at (269) 467-5552.
City, Township, & Village Listing
Click a city, township, or village from the list to view its starting tax map information.
To view the Recorded Plat, click on the Subdivision Name.
To view the Associated Property Tax Map, click on the Quarter Section.
